title: Your Lagos airport transfer checklist: 8 things to sort before you land
excerpt: A calm arrival is mostly planning. Here is what to confirm before you fly, and what to do when your flight runs late.
body:
## Start with the details that cannot change

A good airport pickup is decided before you reach the airport. Spend five minutes on the points below and the rest of the journey gets easier.

## 1. Book with your flight details

Give the booking your real flight number. RideArrivo tracks your flight, so your driver meets you when you land, even if the plane is early or late.

## 2. Know your fare before you confirm

You see the fare before you confirm anything. If a number looks different at pickup, go back to the fare shown in the app.

## 3. Choose how you will pay

You can pay by card, from your RideArrivo wallet, or with a membership. Decide before you travel so you are not looking for a signal at arrivals.

## 4. Check your driver in the app

Every driver passes ID and licence checks. Before you meet them, you can see their name, photo and ID, so match the details to the person who greets you.

## 5. Plan for the unexpected

If your plans change, cancel at least 48 hours before pickup for a full refund. After that you can still get 50% back.

## 6. Share your trip

Tell a family member or colleague your flight, your pickup time and your destination address. It takes one message.

## 7. Charge your phone

Your phone is your ticket, your map and your link to your driver. Keep a power bank in your hand luggage.

## 8. Know where you are going next

Save the exact address, a landmark and a contact number for your destination. It helps your driver and it helps you.

## Ready when you are

When your plans are settled, [book your airport transfer](https://www.ridearrivo.com/book.html).
